newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Monday after rising during the day due to the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.

Firmer overseas markets, caused by rainfall which has disrupted tapping, also supported the market, they said. Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 0.5 yen firmer than the day's close. The benchmark February contract was 0.4 yen firmer at 145.4 yen. Volume was 7,438 lots.
"The benchmark February contract could test the recent high of 147.0 yen marked in July if rainfall in Thailand continues," one trader said.
